entities.name: Agios Ioannis Theologos, Kythnos
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Saint John the Theologian is a Greek Orthodox church and a historical monument located in Chora, on the island of Kythnos, Greece. The church is dedicated to John the Evangelist.
